_doc: Per-asset provenance & licence rules (spec §5 asset/licence contract). The FIRST rule whose regex matches a path under public/ applies. tools/validate/assets.mjs expands these into asset-manifest.json with size and SHA-256; tests/assets/manifest.test.ts fails if any shipped file is unmatched. 'commercial' is our reading of the stated terms, not legal advice. Retrieval dates are those recorded in v3.2 (2026-10-08) unless stated.
